ModMetaData.name: Megabees Renew
ModMetaData.author: zoura3025 - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
The megabee, brought forward to RimWorld 1.6. A stingless, docile, enormous honeybee engineered to produce rather than to sting.
I am not the author of this mod. The bee is zoura3025's; all I did was the work needed to make it run on 1.6. Credit goes to them, mistakes in the update are mine. If they come back to it, or ask me to take this down, it comes down.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830700043 - last supporting 1.4, last updated in January 2023. Abandoned, not withdrawn.
WHAT IT ADDS
One animal and the four things it makes. The megabee has body size 5.25, larger than a muffalo, and moves at 1.4 cells per second, slower than a colonist walking. Sixty-five years of life, worth 500 silver, wildness 0.80, and it cannot be trained at all. It eats rough vegetation and trees both, and it eats a great deal of it.
- Megabee wool, shearable every three days. Stiff rather than soft, good in heat, and very durable. - Megabee tallow, milked rather than churned, which is what the hive would otherwise make honey with. - Megabee eggs, fertilized and unfertilized: two or three every day and a half, like a chicken that weighs as much as a cow. - Megabee tallow salve, a healing item craftable at a crafting spot or a drug lab.
It also brings its own body plan: a thorax, an abdomen, a metathorax, a trophylactic stomach and a reproductive tract, so wounds and surgery land where a bee has parts rather than where a quadruped does.
WHAT CHANGED IN THE 1.6 UPDATE
One line. Wildness stopped being a field of RaceProperties in 1.6 and became a StatDef declared under statBases. The old form is not an error, it is simply never read, and the stat defaults to -1, outside the range the game uses - so the bee tamed for almost nothing instead of sitting at 0.80.
Nothing else needed touching. No balance value was changed.
Content mod: removing it mid-save will lose any megabee, and any megabee wool, tallow, egg or salve already in play.
Source, changelog and the full account of the port: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Megabees-Renew
The original states no licence anywhere - no file, nothing in its About, no repository, nothing on its Workshop page. This port therefore rests on the Workshop's own custom for abandoned mods: named credit to the author, and a takedown on request.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic).
